messages:
deploy-bot: Finished rollout v1.28.3 -> us-west-2 (10% -> 100%) at 1733337777. Release notes: perf tweaks, embed route cache warmup. :rocket:
smokewatch-bot: Synthetic probe summary (first 5m post-rollout): embed-route p95 410ms (baseline 210ms), error rate 0.3% (baseline 0.1%). Alerting on p95 delta > 150ms.
marie: seeing the same on our dashboards, p95 spike aligns with rollout window. traces show extra KV warmups.
aj: can we pause rollout back to 20% while we triage? current 100% feels risky. :thinking_face:
marie: +1 hold at 20%/pin. If we hold we avoid more customer impact.
deploy-bot: Rolling back traffic to 20% now per request from @marie. Current release instances kept, routing reduced.
sanjay: quick local check — ran 10 curl synth calls to embed-route (usw2 edge) after hold: 2 failures, latencies: [230, 240, 420, 410, 225, 235, 405, 430, 220, 215] ms. Seems bimodal.
lena: that matches KV-cache cold path. Suggest we re-run warmup job for prefix caching and remeasure. I can trigger warmup job if we decide to hold.
aj: please run warmup. Also, can we pin the older quantized model variant for embeddings on the route as a fallback if warmup doesn't help?
marie: pin sounds good as backup. @lena trigger warmup, @aj prepare pin PR. We need decision within 20m.
lena: warmup job started at 1733337802. Logs: `warming prefixes: 1200 keys queued, batch size 64`
smokewatch-bot: Warmup progress: 30% complete. Next synthetic sample expected in ~45s.
sanjay: reran 10 calls at 1733337810: latencies now [220, 225, 230, 240, 235, 228, 222, 238, 219, 226] ms. No failures. p95 ~240ms.
aj: good — warmup helped. I'm still opening a pin PR in case tail instability returns.
marie: ok let's keep traffic at 20% for another 10m, monitor, then resume if p95 stays <300ms and error rate stable. No rollback for now. Document decision in release notes. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Traffic held at 20% as of 1733337812. Action items: @aj create pin PR, @lena add warmup to postdeploy step for embed-route, @marie update release notes with probe delta and mitigation.
